name: hcapp_sendEventMessage
description: Sends an event chat message. Inserts the message into HC.EventMessage, updates the sender's EventMessageBadgeCounts (MERGE), then returns three result sets: the inserted message, the list of users who qualify for a full push notification, and the list of users who get an in-app-only notification. Token validated against DeviceSecret + eventId.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Internal event ID as a STRING (not UNIQUEIDENTIFIER). DATALENGTH check: 72 bytes = 36-char UUID in NVARCHAR. This allows the type to be passed as a string for concatenation in token validation.

parameters.name: messageTitle
parameters.description: Message title. If null, overwritten from Event.EventName via COALESCE.

parameters.name: messageContent
parameters.description: The message body. Required — empty string triggers validation error.

parameters.name: messageReleasabilityFlags
parameters.description: Bitfield: 0x0001=Mismanagement, 0x0002=Members, 0x0004=Followers, 0x0008=RSVPs, 0x0010=Hares, 0x0020=Everyone. At least one bit in 0x003F must be set.

rowsets.name: ValidationErrors
rowsets.description: Multiple error rowsets possible without RETURN (see getEventMessages pattern). Auth failure and content validation DO return. Standard error format.

columns.name: MessageRelesabilityFlags
columns.description: NOTE: Column name has a typo — 'Relesability' not 'Releasability'. This is the column name callers must use.

columns.name: EventChatMessageCount
columns.description: Always 0 — hardcoded. SP comment notes this is obsolete as of 2.1.3.

rowsets.name: FullPushNotificationRecipients
rowsets.description: Users who qualify for a full push notification (based on notification preferences, membership, releasability flags, and whether event is within 6-hour notification window).

rowsets.name: InAppOnlyNotificationRecipients
rowsets.description: Kennel members who did not qualify for a full push notification — get an in-app realtime update instead.

sideEffects: MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts (upsert — marks message as read for the sender)

codeSmells.detail: Passed as string so it can be concatenated into the token derivation. Forces callers to pass UUID as string. Should be UNIQUEIDENTIFIER with explicit CAST for token concatenation.

codeSmells.issue: Multiple error paths emit rowsets without RETURN
codeSmells.detail: deviceId, messageId, and hasherId null checks emit SELECT without RETURN. If multiple checks fire, the caller receives multiple error rowsets.
'Relesability' missing a letter — this is a breaking change to fix because callers depend on the exact column name.
The notification window is hardcoded as 6 hours. Should be a kennel-level configuration.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never rename the MessageRelesabilityFlags column without updating all callers
Never change the releasability bitflag values without updating all callers
